supportingSources.label: High Hand scoring and restoration notes
Kineticist High Hand and Capt. Card guide

strategy.summary: Complete whole suits, stop at fifteen cards when the Captain Card add-a-ball has no value, then repeat the built bonus at the center saucer from a slow side angle.

quickInfo.name: Edition
quickInfo.summary: High Hand is the replay version; Capt. Card is the add-a-ball version, so the sixteenth-card saucer award differs.

quickInfo.name: Suit targets
quickInfo.summary: Each suit has four card targets, so finish one complete suit before another when the shot choice permits it.

quickInfo.name: Partial-suit bonus
quickInfo.summary: One, two, or three cards in an incomplete suit add only 100, 200, or 300 to the bonus.

quickInfo.name: Complete-suit bonus
quickInfo.summary: A complete suit adds 4K to the bonus, making three completed suits worth much more than twelve scattered cards.

quickInfo.name: Bonus collect
quickInfo.summary: The center saucer and side outlanes collect the built bonus, but a center drain does not; fifteen cards make the saucer worth 12,300.

quickInfo.name: Sixteenth card
quickInfo.summary: High Hand lights Special; Capt. Card changes the saucer to add-a-ball, which can erase the repeatable 12,300 collect when disabled.

steps.text: Identify High Hand or Capt. Card and confirm what the sixteenth-card saucer award scores.
Read the four suit banks. Choose the suit that is closest to completion and safe from the current flipper.
From a cradle, attack the upper diamonds and spades. Use the lower clubs and hearts from slower inlane feeds.
Backhand the Q-J diamonds or A-K spades when that angle is available.
Finish one whole suit before you spread shots across other banks.
Build three complete suits plus three cards in the fourth suit, stopping at fifteen when Capt. Card's add-a-ball is disabled.
Send a slow, side-angle ball toward the center saucer to collect 12,300, then repeat it while the feed remains controlled.
If the saucer rejects the ball, recover control before you resume suit work.

fallback.title: One-suit completion
fallback.when: Use this when the center saucer does not hold or several suit banks are dangerous.

steps.text: Choose the suit with the fewest standing targets.
Use safe outer-edge hits instead of center hits on the upper banks.
Complete the suit for its 4K bonus value.
Protect the built bonus and wait for an indirect saucer feed.

alternatives.title: Indirect saucer collect
alternatives.when: Use this when a direct center shot is too fast or rejects from the rim.

steps.text: Shoot toward a gap beside an upper card bank.
Let the ball fall toward the angled center-lane guide.
Nudge the slow rebound toward the saucer.
Use a soft slingshot bank only when that feed is repeatable.
Complete one four-card suit at a time.
Stop at fifteen cards with three complete suits and three cards in the fourth.
Repeat the 12,300 center saucer from a slow side angle.
Take the sixteenth card only when its High Hand Special or Capt. Card add-a-ball has more value.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the Q-J diamonds or A-K spades when the same-side angle is controlled.

techniques.name: Slow saucer bank
techniques.instruction: Bank the ball from the opposite slingshot toward the center saucer. Use the reduced speed to limit rim-outs.

cautions.issue: Drop-target rebounds can return toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Aim at a standing target. Avoid the exposed rubber where a target is already down.

cautions.issue: A fast direct saucer shot can rim out and continue down the middle.
cautions.response: Use a slow side-angle shot. Prefer a guide or slingshot bank when it works on this machine.

cautions.issue: Side-chute and V-divider exits can feed the center drain.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready. Nudge before the ball hits the divider when the path is clear.

checkBeforePlay: Identify High Hand, Capt. Card, Top Hand, or King Game; confirm the sixteenth-card saucer award and its tournament conversion.
Confirm ball count, target reset, bonus memory, Extra Ball or Special handling, and tilt before choosing fifteen or sixteen cards.
Test upper-bank rebounds, center-saucer hold and eject, side guides, slingshot banks, flipper strength, and outlane feeds.
strategy.simpleOverview: High Hand and Capt. Card make complete four-card suits far more valuable than scattered cards. Finish one suit at a time, stop at fifteen cards when the sixteenth-card award has no value, and repeat the 12,300 center-saucer collect from a slow side angle.
strategy.overview: High Hand and Capt. Card build the center-saucer bonus through sixteen suit targets, with complete suits worth far more than partial ones. Stop at fifteen cards by completing three suits and taking three cards from the fourth, then repeat the 12,300 saucer from a controlled side angle. The sixteenth card changes the saucer to Special or add-a-ball, so take it only when that configured award is worthwhile.
